name: Volume Texture Mapping with ROI
definition: A technique to render volumetric data using 3D texture mapping by defining a Data Region of Interest (ROI) within the source data and a Geometry ROI in world space, allowing rendering of sub-volumes without copying data.
summary: Volume Texture Mapping with ROI renders volumetric sub-volumes without data copying by mapping a data region of interest to a geometry region, operating on dense grid textures managed by the OpenGL pipeline.
